 About the Company
 



 Trubot Inc. is a robotics company focused on intelligent inspection robots and automation solutions for data center operations. We build and deploy real\-world robotic systems across multiple domains.
 



 Role Summary
 



 We are hiring Robotics Software Engineers for two separate tracks:
 



 Track A: Robotic Manipulation (Mechanical Arm)
 



 Track B: Mobile Robotics
 



 These are two independent hiring tracks, and candidates are only expected to have strong experience in one domain. Experience in both areas is not required.
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Develop and maintain ROS/ROS2\-based robotic systems
 



 Design and implement control, perception, navigation, and system integration modules
 



 Work closely with hardware and system teams for real\-world deployment
 



 Debug and optimize robotic performance in field environments
 



 Build and maintain reusable software modules and internal tools
 



 Track A: Robotic Manipulation (Mechanical Arm)
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Develop robotic arm control systems
 



 Implement FK/IK, trajectory planning, and motion control
 



 Integrate manipulation frameworks (e.g., MoveIt)
 



 Support end\-effector integration and system\-level testing
 



 Requirements
 



 Experience with robotic arms or manipulation systems
 



 Strong understanding of kinematics and control
 



 Familiarity with MoveIt or similar frameworks
 



 Track B: Mobile Robotics
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Develop autonomous navigation and motion planning systems for mobile robots
 



 Implement localization, mapping, SLAM, path planning, and obstacle avoidance algorithms
 



 Integrate LiDAR, cameras, IMU, and onboard sensors into robotic systems
 



 Support real\-world deployment, testing, and debugging of autonomous mobile robots
 



 Requirements
 



 Experience with mobile robots, AGV, AMR, or autonomous robotic platforms
 



 Strong expertise in navigation, localization, SLAM, motion planning, or related robotics algorithms
 



 Experience with ROS/ROS2 navigation stack or similar robotics frameworks
 



 Familiarity with perception and sensor integration workflows
 



 Common Requirements (Both Tracks)
 



 MS or above in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields
 



 Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and/or Python
 



 Experience with ROS or ROS2
 



 Familiarity with Linux development environment
 



 Experience in robotic system integration and debugging
 



 Preferred
 



 Experience in real\-world robotic deployment
 



 Sensor integration (LiDAR, camera, IMU)
 



 Simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac Sim)
 



 Experience with autonomous inspection robots or industrial automation systems

 Fremont, CA (Onsite)
